title: High-Efficiency Double-Stranded cDNA Synthesis from dsRNA Templates
author: Abdonaser Poursalavati
materials: Step 3: Incubation - Denaturation Place the tubes in a thermocycler and run the following program: - 5 minutes at 95°C - Hold at 4°C Immediately after the program finishes, place the tubes on ice for at least 1 minute.

Step 6: Incubation - First-Strand Synthesis Return the tubes to the thermocycler and run the following program: - 10 minutes at 23°C (for primer annealing) - 30 minutes at 55°C (for reverse transcription) - 10 minutes at 80°C (to inactivate the enzyme) - Hold at 4°C After the program finishes, place the tubes on ice for at least 1 minute. You can proceed to the next step or store the samples at -20°C.

Step 9: Incubation - Second-Strand Synthesis Return the tubes to the thermocycler and run the following program:- 150 minutes (2.5 hours) at 16°C- 20 minutes at 75°C (to inactivate enzymes)- Hold at 4°C

steps.title: Reagent preparation and master mix calculation
steps.instruction: Thaw all reagents on ice, briefly centrifuge tubes before opening, keep enzymes on ice or in a cold block, and calculate master‑mix volumes for your number of samples (n) plus an extra 0.5 reaction (n+0.5) as indicated in the Excel calculator.

steps.title: Prepare denaturation master mix
steps.instruction: In a nuclease‑free tube assemble the denaturation master mix for a single reaction using the volumes specified in the protocol, then multiply each component by n+0.5 to create the master mix.

steps.title: Set up denaturation reaction
steps.instruction: In individual nuclease‑free PCR tubes add 10 µL dsRNA template and 3 µL First‑Strand Master Mix #1 (denaturation mix) to a total volume of 13 µL, mix gently by pipetting and centrifuge briefly.

steps.title: Prepare first‑strand RT master mix
steps.instruction: While the denaturation reaction is incubating, prepare the First‑Strand Master Mix (RT Mix) in a nuclease‑free tube for a single reaction, including 0.2 µL RNase H; scale all components by n+0.5, vortex thoroughly, and pipette the tiny RNase H volume carefully.

steps.title: First‑strand cDNA synthesis
steps.instruction: Add 7 µL of First‑Strand Master Mix #2 to each 13 µL denaturation reaction on ice, bringing the total volume to 20 µL; mix gently by pipetting and centrifuge briefly.

steps.title: Second‑strand cDNA synthesis
steps.instruction: To each 20 µL first‑strand reaction add 5.2 µL Second‑Strand Master Mix #3, resulting in a final volume of 25.2 µL; mix gently by pipetting and centrifuge briefly.

steps.title: SPRI bead purification of ds‑cDNA
steps.instruction: Perform a standard SPRI bead cleanup using a bead‑to‑sample ratio of 1.8× (≈45 µL beads for a ~25 µL sample). Follow the bead manufacturer’s instructions for binding, washing with 80 % ethanol, and eluting the purified ds‑cDNA in 20–30 µL nuclease‑free water or buffer. The purified cDNA is now ready for quantification and library preparation.

substeps.instruction: Add 45 µL SPRI beads to the ~25 µL sample (1.8× ratio).
Incubate to allow binding, then place on magnetic rack and discard supernatant.
Wash beads twice with 80 % ethanol, allowing brief incubation each wash.
Elute ds‑cDNA in 20–30 µL nuclease‑free water or buffer.
